event_description: Fires when a user transitions from signed-out to signed-in (any provider: Google, email OTP, password, or anonymous).
Fires when the user explicitly signs out of the app.
Fires when the user successfully deletes their account.
Fires when a user creates a new expense-splitting group.
Fires when a user joins an existing group via invite link or token.
Fires when a user leaves a group they belong to.
Fires when a user adds a non-app member (placeholder) to a group, indicating proxy assignment.
Fires when a user adds a new expense to a group, with split_mode as a property.
Fires when a user edits an existing expense, indicating engagement depth.
Fires when a user deletes an expense, a potential churn or correction signal.
Fires when a user records a payment to settle outstanding balances, the core value-delivery moment.
Fires when a user creates an itemized bill (split-the-bill feature), measuring AI/itemized feature adoption.
